messages:
sam (sre): Heads up — us-west-3 warm-pool joins started failing right after the egress rule tighten. Keystore decrypts timing out and audit-forwarder QPS spiking. Anyone else seeing this?

maria (infra): Yep, seeing `keystore-proxy ERROR decrypt failed: upstream timeout`. Audit exporter shows a sharp burst at 16:59 UTC.

alex (network): natgw conntrack counts climbing in usw3. Audit shipper -> s3 proxy fanout looks like it's exhausting NAT conntracks which then breaks keystore handshakes.

june (ops): Controller logs: multiple `node join: decrypt failed (504)` across warm-pool replicas. Reproduced on 3 hosts.

ops-bot: [ALERT] keystore-proxy-usw3 p95=28s 5xx=12% triggered at 2025-03-12T16:59:50Z

sam (sre): I rolled back the egress tighten on warm-pool subnets (reopened egress to keystore and audit-exporter). Can people confirm if joins recover?

maria (infra): After rollback, keystore errors drop immediately. A handful of nodes still in backoff but joining slowly.

alex (network): Short-term: bump NAT conntrack and add conntrack-protect rules for keystore traffic. Long-term: move audit shipping off NAT (privatelink or VPC endpoint).

june (ops): Also recommend throttling audit exporter while we stabilize. Suggest `--audit-sample-rate=0.15` to cut peak QPS.

security-helm: We can't leave broad egress open for compliance. Need a scoped plan: minimal keystore allowlist + reduce audit fanout. Can we allowlist only warmpool instances?

sam (sre): Plan: 1) rollback (done). 2) throttle audit exporter (maria). 3) bump conntrack + scoped allowlist for warmpool (alex). 4) schedule change to move audit shipper to privatelink (security-helm + infra).

maria (infra): Pushing a canary patch: `kustomize patch: auditExporter.sampleRate=0.15` to 3 pods now.

alex (network): Terraform outline for conntrack bump/allowlist ready; will open PR.

june (ops): Filed INC-4521 for this incident, added rollback notes. Link: https://incidents.redwood/INC-4521

sam (sre): Quick postmortem note: keystore 5xxs look like upstream timeouts from NAT saturation, not cert rotation. Logs show upstream 504s and TCP retries.

maria (infra): Monitoring steady 12m after rollback, onboarding at ~0.7x normal. Continuing watch for 30m.

security-helm: For compliance RFC: prefer staged network changes with audit-sampler defaults and canary windows. We'll review warmpool allowlist and privatelink plan.

sam (sre): Action items: maria toggles sampler on canary; alex patches natgw conntrack + implement allowlist; security-helm to author privatelink RFC; june to update INC ticket. I'll close when warm-pool back to baseline.

maria (infra): Canary rollout started on 3 pods.

alex (network): PR opened for allowlist + conntrack variable, pinging reviewers.

june (ops): Noted recovery in INC-4521, holding for final verification.

sam (sre): Thanks all — keeping thread open until stable. Will post final status in 30m. :thumbsup:
